label: Exploratory continuous-futures research simulation
explanation: Price correlation is 0.989. Correlation measures co-movement, but does not establish mean reversion.
ADF p-value 0.0167: at the 5% level the test rejects the unit-root null; this is evidence of stationarity.
Engle–Granger p-value 0.0324: the test rejects the no-cointegration null; this supports a long-run relationship.
Engle–Granger estimates its own hedge coefficient. A significant result does not prove that the equal-quantity Brent minus WTI spread is stationary.
These full-sample tests describe this sample only. They do not guarantee future mean reversion or profitable trading, and do not filter the strategy.

provenance.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance; unadjusted daily Close

strategy.execution: Signal at close t executes at close t+1; first P&L at close t+2; final liquidation with costs

limitations: Continuous futures proxies are not executable expiry-matched contracts; roll transitions and adjustments can distort P&L.
In-sample illustrative simulation; no out-of-sample validation, roll trades, margin or liquidity model.
A $15.93/barrel absolute spread jump on 2026-04-01 is present in the source; cause is not established and observations were not removed.
